resources.string: Reduce sensor noise using your phone. This works offline. Preparing the preview can take a few minutes and keeps the original untouched.
Preview ready. Choose a strength and apply it to the photo.

This tool requires a Bayer RAW whose sensor data can be decoded. For other photos, use the luminance and color noise controls in Detail.
